stem: According to the passage, which activity requires borrower registration?

choices.text: Attending the indoor talk
Joining the gathering under cloudy skies
Taking binoculars beyond the marked viewing area
Listening to the hilltop sky talk

explanation: The restriction explicitly attaches to taking equipment beyond the marked area. Attendance and listening remain open, and cloud cover changes the talk’s location rather than the registration rule.

stem: Why is the proposed comparison relevant?

choices.text: It would hold light more constant while comparing insect access, reducing one competing explanation
It would hold insect access constant while comparing light, directly testing the effect of more insect visits
It would make watering vary with insect access so the two effects could be attributed to insects alone
It would settle the cause from the original results without needing another observation

explanation: Equal-light covers would better isolate insect access from the light difference. Holding insect access fixed while varying light tests a different comparison; confounding watering introduces another explanation; a proposed future comparison is not a completed causal result.

stem: What is the editor’s main purpose in retaining the disagreement?

choices.text: To preserve distinct recollections while making their limits visible
To show that every recollection is equally accurate in every detail
To prove that the dock workers never agreed on anything
To avoid giving readers any information about dates

explanation: The editor retains each account and supplies dates rather than flattening disagreement into one story. This preserves usable detail and visible limits; it neither certifies all details nor hides dates or generalizes to all workers.

stem: Which summary best captures the curator’s reasoning under the supplied rules?

choices.text: The photograph establishes intact dispatch; the receipt establishes only the box count, so receipt alone cannot establish intact carrier handover
The photograph establishes the earlier condition but not the post-packing condition; the receipt establishes intact contents as well as count
The photograph and receipt establish their respective date/count facts and therefore together prove the carrier caused the damage
The photograph supports its dated condition and the receipt a box count; neither alone supplies the later intact-condition findings proposed

explanation: The photograph’s date gap prevents establishing post-packing condition; the receipt records boxes rather than contents. One rival correctly limits the receipt but overextends the photograph; another correctly limits the photograph but overextends the receipt. Promoting the two limited facts into carrier causation is also unsupported. Both evidential limits must be retained.

stem: Which assessment best connects the findings to both parts of the proposed remedy?

choices.text: The returned reports establish N’s superiority; random assignment alone would recover the missing outcomes
The reported advantage may reflect experience composition; assignment addresses that issue, while follow-up addresses missing outcomes
Equal within-group report rates prove every novice failed; follow-up would only confirm the known failures
Missing reports prove that selection of varieties was random; assignment would address only nonresponse

explanation: Experienced growers chose N more often, so the aggregate reported difference need not be a variety effect. Random assignment addresses that selection issue; follow-up addresses unknown outcomes among nonrespondents. Similar observed rates do not establish the missing outcomes, and assignment cannot retrospectively recover them.
